catalyst_rows.raw_text: The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the Offering to fund future clinical trials for the Company's drug candidates, including for absence seizures, DEE, and Prader-Willi Syndrome, as well as initiation of phase 1 clinical drug trials for BMB-105, and additional research and development work on earlier phase programs, as well as for general corporate and working capital purposes.

extractor_notes.blockers: FPI filings dominated by financing and interim financials; only one BMB-105 Phase 1 initiation date with year precision.
